approach: Game-specific static recompilation with strict, independently checked PPU function tests.
notes: Private Windows development builds reach menus and gameplay, load saves, and have exercised ultrawide, experimental 60 FPS, hybrid path tracing and DLSS. No public playable build exists; this repository holds research and validation tools. Open work: 60 FPS garment and hair motion, audio continuity, PT/DLSS performance and a clean-machine player builder. Linux/Steam Deck and Android are planned targets.
